name: 崇福寺大雄宝殿
checkpoints: Exactly TWO roof levels: broad lower Chinese-style hall and smaller upper Japanese-style roof, no pagoda storeys.
Preserve photographed red pillars, white side walls, grey tiled hip-and-gable roofs, open front gallery and stone staircase.
Exclude attached neighboring halls, offering boxes, people and signage; plaques remain blank.
